answer: Voting power is capped per identity, so even if an attacker controls thousands of accounts each one can only influence a verdict by a tiny fixed amount, and the total is still limited by how much genuine, recent work the cluster can honestly submit. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows..
